source: Minchat Shai on Exod 1:17 (his collation vs the printed Masorah; the Hilleli; the Ramah)
claim_en: ha-MEYALDOT ('the MIDWIVES'): the Great Rabbinic Bible's Masorah note here says 'unique, and lean' — and MS rules it an ERROR ('ta'ut hu — for ALL of them are lean'): so it is written in the Hilleli copy, so a manuscript Masorah, and so the Ramah's record ('ha-meyaldot, la-meyaldot — all of them lean'). The stream verifies the ruling WHOLE: the FULL spelling stands ZERO times in the Torah — the empty census — while the lean midwife-word stands nine times: the two Genesis midwives (Rachel's at 35:17, Tamar's at 38:28) and the seven stations of this chapter (1:15, 1:17, 1:18, 1:19 twice, 1:20, 1:21): the letter thins every midwife in the Torah, and the printed note's 'unique' dissolves under the collation.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 1:19 (the Masorah's unique-lean)
claim_en: el-HEN ('TO THEM' — 'before the midwife comes to them'): 'this one alone is written אלהן LEAN, no yod — and the rest of the Torah, all of them FULL' (MS): the census verifies — the lean to-them stands ONCE in the Torah, inside the midwives' excuse-verse itself, and the full form's Torah stations are exactly two (the king's own speech at 1:17, 'as the king of Egypt SPOKE TO THEM,' and Deut 1:22): the letter thins the word at the verse where the coming is denied — the midwife who does NOT arrive in time carries the thinned arrival-word.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 1:11 (the small Masorah; Ibn Ezra; Rav Pealim — his own cross-ref to the Vayigash file)
claim_en: RAAMSES the STORE-CITY: the small Masorah marks the token, and MS rules the pointing — the mem carries a SILENT sheva because the ayin is PATACH (Ibn Ezra; Rav Pealim: 'Pitom and Raamses — resh and ayin patach, samekh tzere'), and MS's own cross-reference closes the loop: 'as I wrote at the end of the Vayigash portion' — the FWD-3 file (Gen 47:11) verified from the OTHER end: the dwelling-land of Israel is רַעְמְסֵס with the resting sheva, the store-city built FOR PHARAOH is רַעַמְסֵס with the patach — one vowel keeps the two cities apart on the map, and the stream carries the patach at this verse exactly as the chain rules (checked in-stream).

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 1:20 (the Ramah's pairing)
claim_en: va-YIREV ha-am ('and the people MULTIPLIED'): the yod with CHIRIQ, one yod written — and the Ramah's record pairs it: 'and let the FOWL multiply in the earth (ve-ha-of yirev, Gen 1:22) — one yod written; and its like: va-yirev ha-am' — the increase of the people under the decree written in the same one-yod skeleton as creation's fifth-day blessing on the swarming birds: the chapter that borrows creation's swarm-verb (1:7) receives creation's increase-spelling from the chain itself (pointing checked in-stream).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 1:7 (the six expressions)
claim_en: paru va-YISHRETZU va-yirbu va-yaatzmu bi-meod meod: the Kitzur counts SIX expressions of increase in the one verse — 'corresponding to the six born at one belly' — and the stream adds the letter's own crown: va-yishretzu ('and they SWARMED') is the swarm-verb's ONLY narrative token in the Torah (census checked — creation's sheretz-word, Gen 1:20-21's waters and the flood's renewal-blessing, lands as a DEED exactly once: on Israel in Egypt): the people fill the land with the vocabulary of the fifth day.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 1:10 (the Masorah's three)
claim_en: ve-NOSAF ('and he too be ADDED'): the Kitzur's Masorah-three — Pharaoh's fear here ('lest he be added to our enemies'), the inheritance clause ('and it be ADDED to the portion of the tribe,' Num 36:3), and the Scripture-third in Proverbs ('there is one who SCATTERS and is added more,' Prov 11:24 — named): the midrash turns the king's own word against him — 'you plan to scatter and diminish them? there is one who scatters and INCREASES': the Torah-side census verifies the two stations exactly (checked), the add-word Pharaoh feared becoming the add-word of the promise.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 1:11 (the Masorah's pair)
claim_en: ANOTO ('to AFFLICT him'): the afflict-word's ONE Torah token (census checked) — and the Kitzur's Masorah-pair reads its Scripture-twin at Amnon and Tamar ('as there, in the matter of intimacy — so here: they afflicted them to reduce them from intimacy, to void the fruitfulness'): the taskmasters' affliction aimed at the SIX-FOLD increase of 1:7 — the pair carried named; the burden-word be-sivlotam beside it opens the burdens-file (the seeing of the burdens, 2:11, armed).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 1:16 (the Masorah's pair; Sota's sign)
claim_en: al ha-AVNAYIM ('upon the BIRTHSTOOL'): the dual-form stands ONCE in the Torah (checked — the eleven stone-skeletons של האבנים all read ha-avanim, 'the stones'; this token alone points ha-AVNAYIM), and the Kitzur's Masorah-pair gives its one Scripture-twin: the POTTER'S WHEEL ('I went down to the potter's house, and behold, he worked upon the avnayim,' Jer 18:3) — with Sota's readings named: the great sign the king taught the midwives (the thighs cold as stones at the crouching), the potter's geometry (a thigh here, a thigh there, the child between), and 'behold, as clay in the hand of the potter': the birth-stool and the maker's wheel, one word.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 1:18 (Sota's measure)
claim_en: va-TECHAYENA ('and they KEPT ALIVE'): twice in this portion — the deed (1:17) and the king's own indictment quoting the deed back (1:18) — and the Kitzur carries Sota's measure on the doubling: 'not enough that they did not kill them — they SUPPLIED them water and food': the letter's repeated life-verb read as two services, refusal and provision (census checked: exactly the two stations); the king's question-word asiten ('WHY have you DONE') carries its own Scripture-pair named (the abomination-charge in Ezekiel — Sota: Pharaoh propositioned them and was refused).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 1:22 (the Masorah's pair)
claim_en: ha-YILOD ('the son that is BORN'): the born-word's ONE Torah token (census checked), and the Kitzur's Masorah-pair reads its Scripture-twin at David ('also the son BORN to you shall surely die,' 2 Sam 12:14): 'as David was punished by evil raised from his own house — Absalom his son rose against him — so Pharaoh: MOSES, raised in his own house, rose against him and brought upon him all the plagues': the decree-verse's own rare word carries the decree's undoing — the child the Nile-order hunts will be drawn from the Nile into the palace itself (2:5-10, armed).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 1:14 (the lean mortar; the four afflictions); Minchat Shai on 1:14
claim_en: be-CHOMER ('with MORTAR'): written LEAN — and the Kitzur reads the thinned skeleton as the letters of be-RaMaCh evarim ('in all 248 LIMBS' — the servitude in every limb, named); the verse's FOUR afflictions counted (hard service / mortar-and-bricks / all field-service / all their service be-farekh) — 'therefore each plague was four plagues; and for the one who counts five, the be-farekh of 1:13 joins' (the plague-arithmetic named, the ten armed); the stream's census: the lean mortar-word stands exactly TWICE in the Torah, both at this run's front — the bondage's mortar here, and the PITCH-AND-MORTAR of the little ark on the Nile (2:3): the substance of the slavery is the substance of the rescue-basket (checked); MS's pointing beside it: va-yemareru with the resh on a simple sheva (asserted).

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 1:1/1:18/1:21/1:22 (accent rulings; the grammarians' dagesh)
claim_en: The chapter's accent-and-dagesh file, MS's rulings landing on the stream's own marks: ve-ELE with REVIA (1:1 — asserted); la-meyaldot with ZAQEF QATAN and la-hen with ZAQEF QATAN (1:18 — both rulings checked against the stream's marks, the summons-verse pausing twice exactly where MS says); BATIM with the tav DAGESHED (1:21 — the grammarians: the dagesh SEPARATES the houses God built for the midwives from batah, the DESOLATION of Isaiah's vineyard — one dot between reward and ruin, asserted); ve-khol ha-BAT with the bet dageshed (1:22 — asserted): five rulings, five marks, all in-stream.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 1:1/1:9/1:10/1:13/1:15/1:17 (named-only files)
claim_en: The opening files, carried NAMED-ONLY with one letter-check: the FINAL LETTERS of 'et YAAQOV ISH' spell the letters of SHABBAT (checked mechanically — tav, bet, shin: 'for the Shabbat and the circumcision they kept in Egypt they were redeemed'); the initials of the opening words read as the mnemonic of twice-Scripture-once-Targum ('one who completes the portion... will live long years'); the initials of 've-ele shemot bene yisrael ha-baim' carry SHIVYA ('captivity') — even in captivity they did not change their names, and for the unchanged names they were redeemed; the verse opens with vav and closes with vav — the TWELVE pillars ('he built it on twelve pillars and it stood'); the BENT AYIN of el AMO (1:9 — a letter-SHAPE the stream cannot carry: named, never merged; 'with seventy souls they came down, and already they have multiplied beyond us'); HAVA in gematria twelve ('he schemed against the twelve tribes' — instrument gap, named); be-FAREKH as be-FE RAKH ('with a soft mouth' — Sota: the enslavement opened as invitation, named); SHIFRA's two readings (the reed-pipe that revives the stillborn / she-beautifies — her Scripture-pair 'by His breath the heavens were beautified,' Job 26:13, named); the midwife-gematrias (ha-meyaldot = Yokheved bat Levi; 'as he spoke to them' = 'that he propositioned them' — named); Raamses read 'rishon mitroses' (first to crumble — named).
